# Arabic WorkVersion DOCX QA

The reproducible synthetic fixture is generated by `scripts/generate-work-version-docx-golden.ts`. It contains no student data or active share link.

```sh
node --import tsx scripts/generate-work-version-docx-golden.ts /tmp/sers-docx-qa
```

On 2026-10-28, the final fixture rendered successfully through `render_docx.py` using LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0. All six page PNGs were visually inspected after correcting logical RTL alignment and mixed numeric-range ordering.

| Page | Verified content |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Arabic cover, frozen version/date and academic labels; 2026–2027 remains in order |
| 2 | Joined Arabic paragraphs, RTL headings, mixed Word 2026 and KPI 78% text |
| 3 | Continued paragraphs, results and recommendations without clipping |
| 4 | Editable two-column RTL evidence table with twelve wrapping rows |
| 5 | Two embedded synthetic PNG previews and Arabic captions |
| 6 | Explicit snapshotted share-reference QR and readable URL |

Headers, numbered footers and explicit section page breaks were visible. The fixture has native Word paragraphs and table cells; its textual pages are not screenshots. OOXML tests additionally verify text escaping, selected evidence, no external relationships, deterministic ZIP bytes and malformed/oversized preview rejection.

Verified fixture size: 16,156 bytes. SHA-256: `dcdc5c60ab8c219a476e8b725b8a33b976782552cffca5c0beff6b5bf4af628a`.

Microsoft Word itself was not opened. The real MySQL integration suite is separate from this rendering inspection and requires the disposable guarded MySQL 8.4 CI database.
